name: Text cleanup
description: Local, deterministic text cleanup. This label does not establish publisher trust or authorize model disclosure.

tools.name: Clean text lines
tools.description: Normalize CRLF and CR to LF, remove trailing ASCII spaces and tabs, remove empty lines, and keep the first occurrence of each line.

tools.name: Normalize separator
tools.description: Replace every literal fullwidth comma with a comma. All other text remains unchanged.
